fusions.name: Wild Spark
fusions.desc: Sparks a bolt of raw arcana that deals 8 arcane damage to the first enemy it meets. Its damage rises 8% per affliction on the target (max 40%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Unleashed Howl
fusions.desc: Releases a pulse of raw magic around you that deals 11 arcane damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocks each back 2 tiles and leaves each [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Candlelit Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 6 seconds, and 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Wisp Hound
fusions.desc: A bonded hound of raw arcana fights beside you, striking enemies within 4.5 tiles for 4 arcane damage every 1.2 seconds.
